specs_json.compute: Dual onboard PCs; optional Spot CORE / CORE I/O (NVIDIA Jetson) payload compute

notes: Boston Dynamics Spot is the industry-reference agile quadruped for industrial inspection, gauge reading, and thermal/acoustic anomaly detection. It carries up to 14 kg of payloads on standardized rails, runs ~90 minutes per hot-swappable 605 Wh battery, and is IP54-rated for wet industrial environments.

failure_modes.name: Hip actuator seal degradation
failure_modes.symptoms: Grinding noise, elevated joint temperature, gait asymmetry warnings in service logs
failure_modes.mitigation: Follow BD annual service intervals; monitor joint torque residuals; replace actuator module at wear threshold

failure_modes.name: Battery pack capacity fade
failure_modes.symptoms: Runtime drops below 60 min, unexpected low-battery sit-downs mid-mission
failure_modes.mitigation: Rotate battery fleet, keep charge between 20-80% in storage, retire packs below 80% state-of-health

failure_modes.name: Stereo camera condensation/occlusion
failure_modes.symptoms: Degraded obstacle avoidance, stumbling on stairs, 'perception degraded' faults in Autowalk
failure_modes.mitigation: Clean lens covers each mission, use anti-fog inserts in humid sites, verify camera health check pre-mission

failure_modes.name: Knee output gearbox wear
failure_modes.symptoms: Backlash growth, position tracking error, audible clicking under load
failure_modes.mitigation: Track cumulative distance/load duty; schedule gearbox inspection at 4000 h or per BD service bulletin

failure_modes.name: Payload port connector corrosion
failure_modes.symptoms: Intermittent payload dropouts, comms errors to Spot CAM/CORE
failure_modes.mitigation: Keep port caps installed when unused, apply dielectric grease, inspect after washdown

failure_modes.name: Fall-induced structural damage
failure_modes.symptoms: Post-fall calibration failure, bent linkages, self-right failures
failure_modes.mitigation: Restrict autonomous ops near unguarded edges, enable stair mode, full inspection and recalibration after any fall
